tldr: AgenticRL uses a GPT agent to automatically design and refine reward functions for UAV navigation in a closed-loop self-improving process, achieving significant performance gains and successful sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: AgenticRL 利用 GPT 代理自动设计和优化无人机导航的奖励函数，通过闭环自我改进过程显著提升性能，并成功实现仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 深度强化学习在实现自主机器人完成复杂导航任务方面展现出显著潜力。然而，其实际应用仍高度依赖人工设计的奖励函数与反复手动调优，这一过程耗时且无法保证目标任务的高成功率。本文提出AgenticRL——一种智能体引导的强化学习框架，可增强无人机（UAV）导航任务在奖励函数设计、策略优化及真实环境部署中的自主性。AgenticRL采用多模态生成式预训练Transformer（GPT）智能体，通过解析任务信息与视觉场景观测生成特定任务的奖励函数，利用近端策略优化（PPO）算法训练策略，随后以诊断包评估训练策略并生成反馈，扮演批判者角色。基于该反馈，智能体可识别失败模式并闭环迭代优化奖励函数。在推理阶段，为进一步发挥多模态GPT智能体能力，AgenticRL通过真实场景图像与自然语言任务信息自动识别当前运行场景，并选择相应的预训练策略执行。该框架在多项导航任务中进行了评估，包括穿越门廊、避障、越障着陆、轨迹跟踪及运动行为学习。实验结果表明，闭环优化流程相较于初始奖励函数将策略性能提升了71%。同时，我们验证了该框架的仿真到现实迁移能力，真实环境任务成功率达91%，仿真-现实准确率为94%。

title: Semantic-weighted ICP for LiDAR Odometry: Class-Aware Residual Reweighting for Robust Scan Registration
summary: LiDAR odometry is a fundamental component of autonomous robotic systems, relying on geometric registration between consecutive point clouds to estimate ego-motion. However, traditional geometric approaches often degrade in dynamic or unstructured environments due to unreliable correspondences caused by moving objects, sparse geometric features, vegetation, and semantically ambiguous structures. Existing works have shown that, some of these limitations can be addressed by introducing semantic information from the environment in the registration process. In this work, we build on this, and show that not all elements in the environment are equally relevant for registration. Hence, we propose a semantic class-weighted ICP for LiDAR odometry. Instead of strictly filtering out points belonging to specific semantic classes, the proposed approach weights the residuals of points belonging to semantic categories based on their expected geometric stability. This strategy enables informative but potentially unstable structures, to contribute to the registration process while mitigating the influence of dynamic objects. The experimental evaluation was conducted on the SemanticKITTI and RELLIS-3D datasets, which include urban, highway, rural, and off-road environments. The empirical results show that the proposed Semantic-weighted ICP improves pose estimation, especially in challenging off-road scenarios where conventional rigid features are scarce. Furthermore, the analysis reveals that the effectiveness of this weighting strategy is highly environment-dependent, influenced by the structural and semantic composition of the scene.
tldr: This paper introduces Semantic-weighted ICP, a LiDAR odometry method that reweights point residuals according to the semantic class of the point, improving registration robustness in dynamic and unstructured environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出语义加权ICP，根据点的语义类别重新加权残差，提高动态和非结构化环境中激光雷达里程计的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 激光雷达里程计是自主机器人系统的基础组成部分，它依赖连续点云之间的几何配准来估计自主运动。然而，传统的几何方法在动态或非结构化环境中常常性能下降，原因是移动物体、稀疏几何特征、植被以及语义模糊的结构会导致不可靠的对应关系。现有研究表明，在配准过程中引入来自环境的语义信息可以解决其中一些局限性。本文在此基础上进一步证明，并非环境中所有元素对配准的贡献程度相同。因此，我们提出了一种用于激光雷达里程计的语义类别加权ICP算法。该方法并非严格过滤掉属于特定语义类别的点，而是根据点所属语义类别的预期几何稳定性对其残差进行加权。这一策略使具有信息价值但可能不稳定的结构能够参与配准过程，同时减轻动态物体的影响。实验评估在SemanticKITTI和RELLIS-3D数据集上进行，涵盖了城市、高速公路、乡村及越野场景。实验结果表明，所提出的语义加权ICP改善了位姿估计，尤其是在传统刚性特征稀缺的具有挑战性的越野场景中。此外，分析表明该加权策略的有效性高度依赖于环境，受场景的结构和语义组成影响。

title: Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory
summary: Robots solving generalist tasks need to be able to ground instructions in their past experience, since humans may refer to notable past events when giving a task (e.g., ``Take me to where the chemical spill happened yesterday''). Since memory limits make storing all past events infeasible, long-term robot memory must be selective, ideally retaining only those episodes with high utility for future tasks. However, future tasks are not typically given a priori for generalist robots. To select generically useful memories, we propose Bayesian surprise as a gating mechanism for memory formation. We present an approach to compute surprise in a semantically rich deployment-agnostic latent space provided by V-JEPA-2. Using our gated episodic memory to augment 4D scene graph-based spatial memory, we show a consistent improvement over state-of-the-art benchmarks in robot question answering, outperforming prior robot memory methods by $\geq12\%$ for temporal, spatial, and binary questions, and surpassing the performance of supervised and non-causal methods with an unsupervised causal method in event segmentation tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces a Bayesian surprise-based gating mechanism for robot episodic memory, using V-JEPA-2 embeddings to selectively store memorable events, improving performance on temporal, spatial, and binary question answering tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯惊讶的机器人情节记忆门控机制，利用V-JEPA-2嵌入选择性地存储难忘事件，在时间、空间和二元问答任务上提升了性能。
summary_zh: 执行通用任务的机器人需要能够将指令与其过往经历相关联，因为人类在下达任务时可能提及显著的历史事件（例如：“带我去昨天发生化学品泄漏的地方”）。由于存储所有过往事件受内存限制而不可行，长期机器人记忆必须具备选择性，理想情况下仅保留对未来任务具有高实用性的片段。然而，通用机器人的未来任务通常并非先验给定。为筛选具有通用价值的记忆，我们提出将贝叶斯惊奇作为记忆形成的门控机制。我们开发了一种方法，在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富且部署无关的潜空间中计算惊奇。通过将这种门控情景记忆与基于4D场景图的增强型空间记忆相结合，我们在机器人问答任务中相比现有最优基准取得持续改进，在时序、空间和二元问题的回答上超越先前机器人记忆方法≥12%，并在事件分割任务中采用无监督因果方法超越监督和非因果方法的性能。

title: CADET: A Modular Platform for Evaluating Distributed Cooperative Autonomy in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary:
Deep learning models are increasingly central to autonomous vehicle (AV) pipelines, yet their integration has traditionally followed a monolithic design where perception, planning, and control execute on a single onboard computer. This design overlooks the emerging paradigm of cooperative autonomy, where vehicles interact with roadside units (RSUs), edge servers, and cloud-hosted intelligence through vehicle-to-everything (V2X) connectivity. Cooperative perception and control improve safety and efficiency, but also introduce systems-level challenges: network latency, compute heterogeneity, and multi-tenant contention, all critically affect real-time decision-making. These challenges are further amplified by the increasing reliance on large foundation models, whose scale necessitates cloud deployment.
  We present CADET (Cooperative Autonomy through Distributed Experimentation Toolkit), a modular platform for systematic and reproducible evaluation of distributed cooperative autonomy systems under realistic deployment conditions. CADET decouples the AV stack into composable modules that can be flexibly deployed across vehicles, infrastructure, and edge/cloud tiers. The framework integrates state-of-the-art models, incorporates trace-driven network and workload emulation, and provides synchronized model-, system-, and task-level instrumentation. Through V2V and V2I experiments, we show that distributed deployment choices fundamentally shape safety, with V2V intent packets outperforming cloud-based perception and RSU-assisted perception sustaining safety until overloaded by concurrent requests. Although designed for AV pipelines, CADET also supports dataset-driven experimentation, enabling systems and ML researchers to benchmark distributed inference workloads independently of full vehicle simulation. CADET is open source, with code and demo available at https://nesl.github.io/cadet-web.
tldr: CADET is a modular platform for evaluating distributed cooperative autonomy in connected autonomous vehicles, integrating V2X connectivity, trace-driven network emulation, and multi-tier deployment to study how latency, compute heterogeneity, and contention affect safety and real-time decision-making.
tldr_zh: CADET是一个用于评估联网自动驾驶汽车中分布式协作自主性的模块化平台，集成了V2X连接、基于追踪的网络仿真和多层部署，以研究延迟、计算异构性和资源争用如何影响安全性和实时决策。
summary_zh:
深度学习模型日益成为自动驾驶汽车（AV）管线的核心，但其集成传统上遵循一体化设计模式，即感知、规划与控制均在单一车载计算机上执行。这种设计忽视了协作式自动驾驶这一新兴范式——车辆通过车联万物（V2X）通信与路侧单元（RSU）、边缘服务器及云端智能进行交互。协作式感知与控制虽能提升安全性与效率，却也带来系统层面的挑战：网络延迟、计算异构性及多租户资源争用，所有这些都会严重影响实时决策。而随着对大型基础模型的依赖日益增加（其规模需要云端部署），这些挑战被进一步放大。

我们提出CADET（通过分布式实验实现协作式自动驾驶的工具包），这是一个模块化平台，用于在真实部署条件下对分布式协作式自动驾驶系统进行系统化、可复现的评估。CADET将自动驾驶软件栈解耦为可组合的模块，这些模块可灵活部署于车辆、基础设施以及边缘/云端各层级。该框架集成了最新模型，融合了基于真实网络流量的网络与工作负载仿真，并提供同步的模型级、系统级及任务级监测手段。通过V2V（车-车）与V2I（车-基础设施）实验，我们证明分布式部署的选择从根本上影响安全性：V2V意图数据包的表现优于基于云端的感知方案，而RSU辅助感知在并发请求导致过载之前能维持安全性能。尽管CADET专为自动驾驶管线设计，它也支持数据集驱动的实验，使系统与机器学习研究人员能够独立于完整车辆仿真来评估分布式推理工作负载。CADET为开源项目，代码与演示可在https://nesl.github.io/cadet-web获取。

title: A 3D Isovist World Model -- Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature
summary: Embodied agents that navigate cities rely on world models that predict how their surroundings will change as they move. But for navigation, what matters is not what the buildings look like; it is where the agent can go. Most world models nonetheless predict appearance, learning how a scene looks rather than the space an agent can move through. Those that do target geometry, such as bird's-eye-view occupancy grids, flatten the three-dimensional environment onto a ground plane, discarding the above-ground and multi-level structure that shapes real navigation. What is missing is a predictive target that captures the navigable geometry an agent actually traverses, without photometric entanglement and without collapsing the third dimension. Our key idea is to model the open volume between buildings, the negative space, encoded as a 3D isovist: a spherical visibility-depth map recording the distance to the nearest surface in every direction. We introduce an embodied world model that predicts the next isovist from a short history of past isovists and a movement action. The prediction is formulated as a depth residual so the decoder inherits sharp building edges, trained with self-rollout scheduled sampling to keep corrupted context on the geometry manifold, and equipped with a persistent latent bird's-eye-view spatial map for cross-path consistency. Our central finding is emergent and unexpected: a single city-blind model trained on Manhattan and Paris develops a cross-city spatial signature, with city identity linearly decodable from its temporal latents far above single-frame baselines, so the signature lives in the learned dynamics rather than in appearance. The representation is lightweight, interpretable, and reproducible, offering a geometric substrate for spatial reasoning in embodied AI, robotics, and urban analysis, released with an open dataset and pipeline.
tldr: This paper proposes a world model that predicts 3D isovist (spherical visibility-depth) maps to represent navigable geometry for embodied agents, and discovers that the model learns a cross-city dynamic signature that is decodable from latent representations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种预测3D等视域（球形可见性深度）地图的世界模型，用以表示具身智能体可导航的几何结构，并发现该模型学习到跨城市的动态特征，可从潜在表示中解码出城市身份。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在城市中导航的具身智能体依赖于世界模型来预测环境随其移动而产生的变化。但对于导航而言，关键并非建筑物的外观，而是智能体能够到达的区域。然而，大多数世界模型仍以预测外观为目标，学习场景的视觉呈现而非智能体可穿越的空间。那些以几何结构为目标的模型（如鸟瞰视角的占据栅格）将三维环境压缩至地平面，舍弃了实际导航中至关重要的地上及多层空间结构。现有方法缺乏一种既能捕捉智能体实际穿越的可导航几何结构、又不受光度信息干扰且不损失三维信息的预测目标。我们的核心思想是对建筑之间的开放空间（即负空间）进行建模，将其编码为三维等视域图（isovist）：一种球面可见性深度图，记录每个方向上到最近表面的距离。我们提出了一种具身世界模型，能够根据过去等视域图的短时序列及运动动作预测下一时刻的等视域图。该预测基于深度残差公式，使解码器能保留清晰的建筑边缘；通过自展开调度采样（self-rollout scheduled sampling）进行训练，确保受损上下文保持在几何流形上；并配备持久化的潜在鸟瞰空间地图以实现跨路径一致性。我们的核心发现具有突发性与意外性：一个在曼哈顿与巴黎训练的单一城市盲模型，竟发展出了跨城市空间特征——城市身份可从其时间潜变量中线性解码，且准确率远超单帧基线。这表明该特征存在于学习到的动力学中，而非外观表现。该表征方法轻量、可解释且可复现，可为具身人工智能、机器人学及城市分析中的空间推理提供几何基础，并随附开放数据集与处理管道发布。

title: CANMOT: Class-Aware Noise Modeling for Multi-Object Tracking in Autonomous Driving
summary:
Kalman filter (KF)-based multi-object tracking (MOT) remains a strong baseline for autonomous driving due to its strong performance, computational efficiency and interpretability. In most practical systems, the process noise and measurement noise covariances are defined globally and shared across object classes, presuming identical uncertainty characteristics across heterogeneous traffic participants.
  This work revisits this assumption and proposes CANMOT, a class-aware and object-aligned noise modeling framework for KF-based 3D MOT. Class-specific diagonal process and measurement covariance matrices are introduced and optionally expressed in the object coordinate frame to preserve longitudinal-lateral anisotropy.
  Systematic experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that class-aware and object-aligned noise modeling improves tracking performance and substantially reduces identity switches compared to state-of-the-art (SotA). In addition, the consistency of the estimated uncertainty is analyzed using the Average Normalized Estimation Error Squared (ANEES) and $χ^2$-based violation tests. The results reveal severe overconfidence in standard KF-based MOT baselines. While the proposed formulation improves calibration without modifying the underlying filtering framework, it still exhibits substantial inconsistency, highlighting the need for further research in this area.
  Code is available at https://github.com/rst-tu-dortmund/learned-3d-nms.
tldr: CANMOT proposes a class-aware and object-aligned noise modeling framework for Kalman filter-based 3D multi-object tracking, improving tracking performance and calibration in autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: CANMOT提出了一种针对自动驾驶中卡尔曼滤波三维多目标跟踪的类别感知和物体对齐噪声建模框架，提高了跟踪性能和校准效果。
summary_zh:
基于卡尔曼滤波（KF）的多目标跟踪（MOT）因其强大的性能、计算效率以及可解释性，仍是自动驾驶领域的一个重要基线方法。在大多数实际系统中，过程噪声和测量噪声协方差被全局定义，并在不同目标类别间共享，这假定了异构交通参与者具有相同的不确定性特征。

本研究重新审视了这一假设，并提出CANMOT，一种针对基于KF的3D MOT的类别感知且目标对齐的噪声建模框架。引入了类别特定的对角过程与测量协方差矩阵，并可选地在目标坐标系中表达，以保持纵向与横向的各向异性。

在nuScenes基准上的系统实验表明，与最先进方法（SotA）相比，类别感知且目标对齐的噪声建模提升了跟踪性能，并显著减少了身份切换次数。此外，利用平均归一化估计误差平方（ANEES）和基于χ²的违例测试分析了估计不确定性的一致性。结果显示，基于KF的标准MOT基线存在严重的过度自信问题。尽管所提出的公式在不修改底层滤波框架的情况下改善了校准效果，但其仍表现出显著的不一致性，凸显了该领域进一步研究的必要性。

代码已开源：https://github.com/rst-tu-dortmund/learned-3d-nms

title: SPADE: Sketch-guided Path Planning Augmented with Diffusion Experts
summary: Path planning is essential for Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs). Conventional methods for incorporating human preferences into planning typically rely on either complex reward engineering or hardware-intensive solutions. Recent state-of-the-art frameworks leverage imitation learning to train behavior-specific path planning models from expert demonstrations. However, these approaches face two key limitations: limited generalization to unseen environments and low robustness in demonstration collection. To address these challenges, this work introduces an enhanced framework that focuses on two main contributions: an overhauled annotation tool built on ROS 2, and a novel training strategy that integrates diffusion-based augmentation into baseline behavioral cloning models. A dataset of expert demonstrations is provided and evaluated through ablation studies to assess the robustness of the proposed solution. The enhanced approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods with 39.1% lower Absolute Pose Error (APE) and 33.5% lower Fr'echet Inception Distance (FID) while having 93.8% less trainable parameters. Moreover it attains diffusion-level generalization while preserving the real-time, on-edge properties of state-of-the-art models.
tldr: This paper presents SPADE, a framework for sketch-guided path planning in autonomous mobile robots that uses diffusion-based data augmentation to improve generalization and robustness over baseline behavioral cloning models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SPADE框架，通过扩散模型数据增强提升自主移动机器人路径规划的泛化性和鲁棒性，优于现有行为克隆方法。
summary_zh: 路径规划对于自主移动机器人（AMR）至关重要。将人类偏好融入规划的传统方法通常依赖于复杂的奖励工程设计或高成本的硬件解决方案。近期最先进的框架利用模仿学习，从专家示范中训练特定行为路径规划模型。然而，这些方法面临两个关键局限：对未知环境的泛化能力有限，以及在示范采集过程中鲁棒性较低。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种增强框架，主要贡献包括：基于ROS 2构建的改进型标注工具，以及一种将扩散增强融入基线行为克隆模型的新型训练策略。我们提供了专家示范数据集，并通过消融实验评估了所提方案的鲁棒性。增强方法在性能上超越了现有最先进技术，其绝对位姿误差（APE）降低了39.1%，弗雷歇初始距离（FID）降低了33.5%，同时可训练参数减少了93.8%。此外，该方法在保持最先进模型实时性与边缘端特性的同时，实现了扩散级别的泛化能力。

title: PerchRL: Vision-Based Agile Perching on Inclined Platforms under Rapid and Irregular Motion
summary: Autonomous vision-based perching of quadrotors on moving inclined platforms is critical for air-ground collaboration but remains challenging due to the limited field of view (FOV). In this paper, we propose PerchRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for vision-based agile perching on inclined platforms under rapid and irregular motion. Specifically, we employ a two-stage learning strategy consisting of state-based pre-training followed by vision-based fine-tuning. To improve generalization across diverse platform motions, we employ randomized platform trajectories to prevent overfitting and temporal augmentation methods to capture latent motion patterns from historical observations. During vision-based fine-tuning, a hybrid learning framework consisting of visibility-aware state augmentation and active perception rewards is presented to improve robustness under intermittent visual loss. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the feasibility, stability, and real-time performance of PerchRL, while successful deployment across distinct quadrotor platforms further validates its adaptability. The source code will be released to benefit the community.
tldr: PerchRL uses a two-stage reinforcement learning framework with state-based pre-training and vision-based fine-tuning to enable quadrotors to autonomously perch on moving inclined platforms, addressing limited FOV and irregular motion through visibility-aware augmentation and active perception rewards.
tldr_zh: PerchRL采用两阶段强化学习框架，通过基于状态的预训练和基于视觉的微调，使四旋翼飞行器能够在移动倾斜平台上自主降落，解决了视野受限和不规则运动问题。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于视觉的自主四旋翼无人机在移动倾斜平台上的降落对于空地协同至关重要，但由于有限的视场角，这一任务仍具有挑战性。本文提出PerchRL，一种用于视觉驱动下在快速且不规则运动的倾斜平台上实现敏捷降落的强化学习框架。具体而言，我们采用两阶段学习策略：先进行基于状态表示的预训练，再进行基于视觉的微调。为提升对不同平台运动模式的泛化能力，我们采用随机化平台轨迹以防止过拟合，并引入时间增强方法从历史观测中捕捉潜在运动模式。在基于视觉的微调阶段，提出了一种结合可见性感知状态增强与主动感知奖励的混合学习框架，以增强在间歇性视觉丢失情况下的鲁棒性。大量仿真与真实世界实验验证了PerchRL的可行性、稳定性及实时性能，其在多种四旋翼平台上的成功部署进一步证明了其适应性。源代码将开源以惠及社区。

title: Reliability-Guided Depth Fusion for Glare-Resilient Navigation Costmaps
summary: Specular glare on reflective floors, glass boundaries, and glossy indoor surfaces frequently corrupts active-stereo RGB-D depth measurements, producing holes and spikes that accumulate as persistent phantom obstacles in occupancy-grid costmaps. This paper presents a glare-resilient costmap construction method based on explicit depth-reliability modeling. A lightweight Depth Reliability Map network (DRM-Net) predicts per-pixel measurement trustworthiness under specular interference, and a reliability-guided weighted-and-gated fusion (RGF) mechanism modulates occupancy updates before corrupted measurements are accumulated into the map. To support robust training and evaluation, the method uses pose-aligned multi-view reference-depth construction to reduce circular-supervision bias and is evaluated through fusion-variant ablations, parameter-sensitivity analysis, cross-condition tests, paired navigation comparisons, reliability-map metrics, and embedded runtime profiling. Experiments on a real mobile robotic platform equipped with an Intel RealSense D435 and a Jetson Orin Nano show that the proposed method reduces false obstacle insertion, improves free-space preservation, and maintains real-time throughput under reflective-floor, glass-wall, and natural-light glare conditions. These results support treating glare as a measurement-reliability problem rather than as a dense depth-completion problem for safety-critical indoor navigation.
tldr: This paper proposes a glare-resilient costmap construction method using a Depth Reliability Map network (DRM-Net) to predict pixel-level depth trustworthiness and a weighted-and-gated fusion mechanism that prevents corrupted depth measurements from creating phantom obstacles, validated on a real mobile robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种抗眩光代价地图构建方法，通过深度可靠性图网络预测像素级深度可信度，并采用加权门控融合机制防止错误深度测量产生虚假障碍，在实际移动机器人上验证了有效性。
summary_zh:
摘要：反射地板、玻璃边界及光滑室内表面产生的镜面眩光常干扰主动立体RGB-D深度测量，导致深度图中出现空洞与尖刺噪声，并在占用栅格代价地图中累积为持续存在的虚拟障碍物。本文提出一种基于显式深度可靠性建模的抗眩光代价地图构建方法。轻量级深度可靠性图网络（DRM-Net）可预测镜面干扰下每个像素的测量可信度，而可靠性引导的加权门控融合机制（RGF）在受损测量值累积至地图前调制占用更新。为支撑鲁棒训练与评估，该方法采用位姿对齐的多视角参考深度构建以减少循环监督偏差，并通过融合变体消融实验、参数敏感性分析、跨条件测试、配对导航对比、可靠性图指标及嵌入式运行时剖析进行验证。在搭载Intel RealSense D435与Jetson Orin Nano的真实移动机器人平台上的实验表明：所提方法可减少虚假障碍物插入、提升自由空间保持能力，并在反射地板、玻璃墙及自然光眩光条件下维持实时吞吐性能。这些结果支持将眩光视为测量可靠性问题而非密集深度补全问题。

title: Extreme Motion Generation via Hybrid Null-Space Control for Straight-Line Path Following
summary: This work studies ``extreme motion generation'', which aims to maximize the Cartesian path length along a pre-defined trajectory within the manipulator's workspace. This objective is important in industry as long as path-following is fundamental to a large variety of tasks such as surface coating and welding. More critically, extreme motion enables a fixed-base manipulator to exploit the kinematic capability under limited reachability. However, such exploitation is challenging in practice, as the manipulator must actively avoid the safety boundary through execution, which is inherently a long-horizon problem. Accordingly, we claim that long-horizon decision-making should be delegated to a learning-based policy to maximize exploitation, while a classical model-based controller covers the near-boundary region, where the learning policy degrades sharply due to sparse data coverage. In detail, our proposed method is a step-level hybrid controller that switches between an RL-based and a model-based controller according to the normalized joint-limit distance. The initial joint configuration is sampled through conditional diffusion-based sampling, which improves the achievable path length based on the learned motion prior. We evaluate the proposed framework on 10,000 straight-line path-following tasks with a 7-DoF Franka FR3, extending the average rollout length by 27\% over the model-based baseline. Notably, certain tasks yield a pronounced extension toward the motion extreme, as reflected in the maximum improvement reported in the statistical results. The project website and related videos of this paper can be found at https://yuan-xinyi.github.io/extreme-motion-generation/.
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid null-space controller that combines an RL-based policy for long-horizon exploitation with a model-based controller for near-boundary safety, enabling a fixed-base manipulator to follow extreme straight-line paths with significantly extended rollout length on a real 7-DoF Franka FR3 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种混合零空间控制器，将基于强化学习的策略用于长时域开发与基于模型的控制器用于近边界安全相结合，使得固定基座机械臂能够跟随极端直线路径，并在真实的7自由度Franka FR3机器人上实现了显著的轨迹长度延长。
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了“极限运动生成”问题，其目标是在机械臂工作空间内，沿预定轨迹最大化笛卡尔路径长度。由于路径跟踪是表面涂覆、焊接等多种任务的基础，该目标在工业领域具有重要价值。更重要的是，极限运动能使固定基座机械臂在有限可达范围内充分利用运动学能力。然而，这种利用在实践中颇具挑战性——机械臂必须在执行过程中主动避开安全边界，这本质上是一个长期问题。据此，我们提出应将长期决策交由基于学习的策略以最大化利用效率，而基于经典模型的控制器则负责覆盖近边界区域——在此区域，学习策略会因数据覆盖稀疏而性能急剧下降。具体而言，我们提出的方法是一种步进级混合控制器，可根据归一化关节限位距离在基于强化学习的控制器与基于模型的控制器之间切换。初始关节构型通过条件扩散采样生成，该采样基于已学习的运动先验提升了可达路径长度。我们在7自由度Franka FR3机械臂上，对10,000条直线路径跟踪任务进行了评估，相较于基于模型的基线方法，平均展开长度提升了27%。值得注意的是，某些任务在运动极限方向上实现了显著延伸，这在统计结果的最大改进值中得以体现。本文的项目网站及相关视频可访问https://yuan-xinyi.github.io/extreme-motion-generation/获取。

title: eMEM: A Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Memory System For Embodied Agents
summary: We present eMEM (Embodied Memory), a hybrid graph-based memory system for embodied agents operating in physical environments. Current agent memory architectures, such as Generative Agents, MemGPT, and A-MEM, treat memory as text streams or knowledge graphs, but embodied agents require memory that is simultaneously searchable by meaning, space, and time. eMEM fills this gap with a multi-index architecture (SQL ITE for structured storage, hnswlib for approximate nearest neighbour semantic search, and an R-tree for spatial queries) unified behind a single graph model. A tiered consolidation pipeline transforms raw perceptual observations into compressed summaries, mirroring hippocampal-neocortical consolidation in biological systems. Ten agent-facing recall tools expose memory retrieval primitives, including concept-to-location resolution and cross layer recall, as first-class operations for LLM tool calling. The system is fully embedded and runs in-process alongside the agent. In addition we introduce eMEM-Bench v1, a benchmark we construct over ProcTHOR-10K scenes for embodied memory evaluation. The benchmark is organised explicitly around eight cognitive-psychology paradigms (DRM lures, pattern separation, pattern completion, source monitoring, context-dependent retrieval, long-horizon interference, serial position, and a foil augmented retention curve), each chosen so that the result is interpretable against the broader memory-systems literature in humans and prior agent-memory systems; a level of diagnostic that surface-task benchmarks like LoCoMo or OpenEQA cannot provide. eMEM scores 80.8 weighted mean over 988 probes, with a flat retention curve at ceiling from 1 h to 1 yr of simulated delay on room-unique items. We show that a pure RAG baseline (the flat_rag ablation) loses 30 pt on context dependent retrieval and 29 pt on DRM lure rejection, isolating the contribution of multi-layer storage and consolidation respectively. We release both the system and the benchmark code.
tldr: eMEM is a hybrid spatio-temporal memory system for embodied agents that integrates SQLite, hnswlib, and R-tree with a tiered consolidation pipeline, and it includes a benchmark (eMEM-Bench v1) of 988 cognitive-psychology probes. The system achieves 80.8 weighted mean probe accuracy with flat retention from 1 hour to 1 year, significantly outperforming a pure RAG baseline.
tldr_zh: eMEM 是一种为具身智能体设计的混合时空记忆系统，结合 SQLite、hnswlib 和 R-tree 以及分层整合管道，并包含一个包含 988 个认知心理学探针的基准测试 (eMEM-Bench v1)。该系统在探针准确率上达到 80.8 加权均值，且在 1 小时到 1 年内保持平坦的保持曲线，显著优于纯 RAG 基线。
summary_zh: 我们提出eMEM（具身记忆），一种面向在物理环境中运行的具身智能体的混合图基记忆系统。当前的智能体记忆架构（如Generative Agents、MemGPT和A-MEM）将记忆视为文本流或知识图谱，但具身智能体需要能同时通过含义、空间和时间进行检索的记忆。eMEM通过单一图模型后的多索引架构（结构化存储使用SQLite、近似最近邻语义搜索使用hnswlib、空间查询使用R树）填补了这一空白。分层整合流水线将原始感知观测转化为压缩摘要，模拟了生物系统中海马体-新皮层的整合过程。十个面向智能体的回忆工具将记忆检索原语（包括概念到位置的解析和跨层回忆）作为语言模型工具调用的第一类操作公开出来。该系统完全嵌入并作为进程内模块与智能体协同运行。此外，我们引入了eMEM-Bench v1——一个基于ProcTHOR-10K场景构建的具身记忆评估基准。该基准明确围绕八个认知心理学范式组织（DRM诱饵、模式分离、模式完成、来源监控、情境依赖检索、长时程干扰、序列位置效应及增强保留曲线），每个范式都旨在使结果能与人类更广泛的记忆系统文献及先前智能体记忆系统进行对照解读——这种诊断深度是LoCoMo或OpenEQA等表层任务基准无法提供的。在988个探测任务中，eMEM的加权平均得分为80.8%，在模拟延迟1小时至1年的房间独有物品测试中表现出天花板效应的平坦保留曲线。实验表明，纯RAG基线（flat_rag消融实验）在情境依赖检索上损失30个百分点，在DRM诱饵拒绝上损失29个百分点，分别隔离验证了多层存储与整合机制的贡献。我们已公开该系统及基准代码。

title: Autonomous Navigation System for Library Service Robot Based on Unitree Go2 Edu
summary: Libraries require autonomous robots to move quietly through narrow aisles while remaining safe around readers, chairs, bags, and carts. This paper presents a ROS 2 navigation system for a Unitree Go2 Edu quadruped equipped with a 4D LiDAR, a front depth camera, and an IMU. Rather than assuming the library is rough terrain, we target the practical mobility discontinuities of real deployments, including floor transitions, temporary clutter, and partially blocked passages where low-clearance wheeled platforms are less tolerant. RTAB-Map is used for visual-LiDAR SLAM, AMCL and EKF-based sensor fusion provide localization, and a Nav2 stack with A* and DWA supports planning and local avoidance. In a real library, the system achieves 100%, 96%, and 88% success rates in static, low-density dynamic, and high-density dynamic scenes, while map validation against surveyed control distances yields a mean metric error of 3.7 cm.
tldr: This paper presents a ROS 2-based autonomous navigation system for a Unitree Go2 Edu quadruped robot in library environments, integrating visual-LiDAR SLAM, sensor fusion localization, and a Nav2 stack with A* and DWA, achieving high success rates in static and dynamic scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文针对图书馆环境，为Unitree Go2 Edu四足机器人设计了一套基于ROS 2的自主导航系统，集成了视觉-激光SLAM、传感器融合定位以及Nav2堆栈（A*和DWA），在静态和动态场景下均取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 图书馆需要自主机器人在狭窄通道中安静移动，同时确保读者、座椅、书包和手推车周围的安全。本文提出了一套基于ROS 2的导航系统，搭载于配备4D激光雷达、前置深度相机和惯性测量单元（IMU）的Unitree Go2 Edu四足机器人上。我们未将图书馆视为崎岖地形，而是针对实际部署中存在的移动连续性障碍——包括地板过渡、临时杂物堆叠以及低间隙轮式平台难以通行的部分受阻通道。系统采用RTAB-Map实现视觉-激光雷达同步定位与建图（SLAM），基于自适应蒙特卡洛定位（AMCL）和扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的传感器融合提供定位能力，并通过集成A*算法与动态窗口法（DWA）的Nav2功能包支持路径规划与局部避障。在真实图书馆环境中，该系统在静态、低密度动态和高密度动态场景下分别达到100%、96%和88%的成功率，而基于实测控制距离的地图验证显示平均度量误差为3.7厘米。

title: RobotValues: Evaluating Household Robots When Human Values Conflict
summary: While household robots are often evaluated based on task completion, everyday domestic environments involve value-conflicting situations in which robots are expected to choose actions that prioritize other values than task success, such as human autonomy, efficiency, or social appropriateness. Yet, there are no benchmarks for evaluating robots' value preferences in such scenarios. We introduce RobotValues, a benchmark to evaluate household robot planners in 10K value-conflict scenarios. Each instance consists of a realistic household image with multiple plausible robot actions that prioritize different human values. We construct RobotValues through LLM-assisted scenario generation, stakeholder-grounded value extraction, image generation and automatic quality control. Using RobotValues we evaluate VLMs used in robotics and find that models exhibit default value preferences, including safety and accommodation, while underselecting privacy-prioritizing actions. When the models are instructed to prioritize specific values that conflict with their own preferences, they often fail to override their default actions, choosing incorrect actions for 80% of the time. These findings suggest that household robot evaluation should measure not only task completion or safety compliance, but also whether robots can choose among plausible actions when human values conflict.
tldr: A benchmark for evaluating household robot planners in value-conflict scenarios, revealing that VLMs have default value preferences and often fail to override them when instructed.
tldr_zh: 一个用于评估家庭机器人在价值冲突场景中规划的基准，揭示了VLM具有默认价值偏好，且在收到指令时常常无法覆盖默认行为。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
虽然家用机器人常以任务完成度作为评估标准，但日常家庭环境中常出现价值冲突情境，此时机器人需选择优先考虑任务成功以外的其他价值（如人类自主性、效率或社会适宜性）的行动。然而，目前尚无针对此类场景中机器人价值偏好的评估基准。我们提出RobotValues这一基准，用于在1万个价值冲突情境中评估家用机器人规划器。每个实例包含一幅真实家庭场景图像及多个符合不同人类价值优先级的可行机器人动作。我们通过大语言模型辅助的场景生成、基于利益相关方的价值提取、图像生成及自动质量控制构建了RobotValues。利用RobotValues评估机器人领域的视觉语言模型后，我们发现这些模型存在默认价值偏好（包括安全性与包容性），但较少选择优先考虑隐私的行动。当模型被要求优先考虑与其自身偏好冲突的特定价值时，它们往往无法覆盖默认动作，且有80%的时间选择错误动作。这些发现表明，家用机器人评估不仅应衡量任务完成度或安全性合规，还应考察机器人在价值冲突情境中能否从多个可行动作中做出正确选择。

title: Wheel-Mounted/GNSS Fusion with AI-Aided Position Updates
summary: Accurate and robust localization remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous ground vehicles. In this work, we propose a hybrid neural inertial navigation framework that integrates a wheel-mounted inertial sensors, enforced periodic trajectories, and a simple, efficient neural network capable of regressing vehicle displacement with GNSS position updates in an error-state extended Kalman filter. The periodic trajectories increase the inertial signal-to-noise ratio, allowing the network to use only inertial readings to estimate displacement. The approach is validated through real-world experiments using multiple wheel-mounted inertial sensors. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a significant improvement in positioning accuracy, reducing the position root mean squared error by approximately 46 % compared to standard wheel-mounted inertial sensor fusion with GNSS updates.
tldr: Proposes a hybrid neural inertial navigation framework that fuses wheel-mounted inertial sensors with GNSS position updates using an error-state extended Kalman filter, achieving 46% reduction in positioning error.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种混合神经惯性导航框架，将轮式惯性传感器与GNSS位置更新通过误差状态扩展卡尔曼滤波器融合，定位误差降低46%。
summary_zh: 高精度且鲁棒的定位仍是自主地面车辆面临的基本挑战。本文提出一种混合神经惯性导航框架，该框架集成了车轮安装式惯性传感器、周期性强制运动轨迹，以及一个简单高效的神经网络。该网络能够在误差状态扩展卡尔曼滤波器中，利用全球导航卫星系统位置更新来回归车辆位移量。周期性运动轨迹提升了惯性信噪比，使网络仅凭惯性读数即可估计位移。通过使用多个车轮安装式惯性传感器的真实世界实验对该方法进行了验证。实验结果表明，与采用GNSS更新的标准车轮安装式惯性传感器融合方法相比，所提方法在定位精度上实现了显著提升，位置均方根误差降低了约46%。

title: ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control
summary: Human demonstrations provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet it is non-trivial to transfer them to execute on real robots due to the kinematic gap. In dexterous manipulation, it remains challenging to track long-horizon, contact-rich sequences even in simulators: a reference-tracking policy must keep objects on their target trajectories while preserving demonstrated joint motion and contact timing. Existing approaches often rely on hand-crafted reward tuning that require per-sequence tuning and break under limited interaction budgets. We introduce ConTrack, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that scales with tracking data. ConTrack treats object tracking as a constraint and allocates remaining control authority to motion fidelity, which allows it to adapt task--style trade-offs online using a dual-variable update. In addition, ConTrack also stabilizes long-horizon learning with an adaptive mid-trajectory reset library that reuses policy-reachable simulator states. Our qualitative and quantitative results in simulation tracking and real robot demonstrate that ConTrack improves success and object pose accuracy significantly over prior arts while preserving joint and contact fidelity. Website: https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/ConTrack.
tldr: ConTrack is an RL framework for constrained hand motion tracking that adaptively balances object tracking and motion fidelity using dual-variable updates and a mid-trajectory reset library, improving success and pose accuracy in dexterous manipulation.
tldr_zh: ConTrack 是一个用于受限手部运动跟踪的强化学习框架，通过双变量更新和中轨迹重置库自适应平衡物体跟踪与运动保真度，提升了灵巧操作中的成功率和物体位姿精度。
summary_zh: 人类演示为机器人操作提供了强大的先验知识，但由于运动学差异，将其迁移至真实机器人执行并非易事。在灵巧操作中，即使是在仿真环境中，跟踪长时域、高接触密度的序列仍具挑战性：参考跟踪策略需在保持演示关节运动与接触时序的同时，使物体沿目标轨迹运动。现有方法通常依赖手工设计的奖励调节，需针对每个序列单独调整，且在交互预算有限时易失效。我们提出ConTrack——一种随跟踪数据规模扩展的强化学习框架。ConTrack将物体跟踪作为约束条件，并将剩余控制权分配给运动保真度，从而通过双变量在线更新实现任务与风格的自适应权衡。此外，ConTrack还通过自适应轨迹中段重置库（复用策略可达的仿真器状态）稳定长时域学习。仿真跟踪与真实机器人的定性与定量结果表明，ConTrack在成功率与物体位姿精度上显著超越现有方法，同时保持关节运动与接触保真度。网站：https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/ConTrack

title: How Visible Are Silent Manipulation Failures? An Observability Study of False-Success Detection in Simulated Robot Episodes
summary: Imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation inherit the quality of the success labels attached to their training episodes, and those labels are usually produced by the robot's own success check. A particularly damaging error is the false success: an episode the robot logs as a success when the task outcome was actually wrong. We ask a narrow but practical question about these episodes. Once an episode has already been flagged as a success, how much of the information needed to overturn that label is present in proprioception, and how much requires vision? We build a simulated testbed on two bimanual ALOHA tasks, induce failures through environment perturbations rather than label edits, label every episode by privileged simulator state that the detector never sees, and keep only episodes the robot flagged as successful. We then compare detectors restricted to proprioception against a vision-based detector. We find that recoverability spans a wide range: in cube transfer the false successes are almost fully recoverable from joint data alone, while in peg insertion proprioception recovers only part of them and a vision detector closes most of the gap. We also show that the proprioceptive separability we measure rests on velocity differences far below any realistic sensor noise floor, so it is best read as an optimistic upper bound that a noiseless simulator inflates. We release the generation and evaluation pipeline.
tldr: This paper studies false-success detection in simulated robot manipulation episodes, finding that proprioception alone can sometimes recover failures but often requires vision, and that simulator noise inflates apparent recoverability.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了模拟机器人操作中的假阳性成功检测，发现仅靠本体感觉有时能识别失败，但通常需要视觉信息，且模拟器噪声会高估可恢复性。
summary_zh: 模仿学习策略在机器人操作中的性能，取决于其训练过程中成功标签的质量，而这些标签通常由机器人自身的成功检测机制生成。一种尤为严重的错误是"虚假成功"：即当任务结果实际错误时，机器人仍将其记录为成功。我们针对这类情况提出一个具体但实用的问题：一旦某个片段已被标记为成功，要推翻该标签所需的信息中，有多少来自本体感知，又有多少需要依赖视觉？我们在两项双臂ALOHA任务上构建了模拟测试平台，通过环境扰动（而非标签编辑）诱发失败，利用检测器从未访问的特权模拟器状态对每个片段进行标注，并仅保留机器人标记为成功的片段。随后，我们将仅基于本体感知的检测器与基于视觉的检测器进行对比。研究发现，可恢复性差异显著：在立方体转移任务中，虚假成功几乎完全可通过关节运动数据恢复；而在插销插入任务中，本体感知仅能恢复部分虚假成功，视觉检测器则能弥补大部分差距。此外，我们证实在本体感知中检测到的可分离性依赖于远低于实际传感器噪声底限的速度差异，因此应将其视为无噪声模拟器所夸大的乐观上限。我们已公开该生成与评估流程。

title: ModuLoop : Low-Level Code Generation using Modular Synthesizer and Closed-Loop Debugger for Robotic Control
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance across various domains, including code generation and problem solving. However, their application in robotic control, particularly in low-level tasks that require precise manipulation, real-time feedback, and environment-dependent execution, remains limited. To address this challenge, we propose the Closed-Loop Modular Code Synthesizer framework. This framework leverages a pre-trained LLM without any task-specific fine-tuning to perform modular code planning and generation, and iteratively executes the generated code while inserting debugging probes to observe its behavior. This closed-loop structure facilitates systematic debugging and refinement, ultimately producing executable control programs. We apply the proposed framework to the calibration of an RGB-D camera and a robotic arm, validating its effectiveness in real-world settings. Furthermore, through a subsequent pick-and-place task, we demonstrate not only the accuracy of the calibration but also the potential extensibility of the framework. Across both tasks, the framework achieved high execution accuracy and autonomy, illustrating the practicality and scalability of LLM-based robotic control using our framework.
tldr: ModuLoop uses a pretrained LLM with modular code generation and a closed-loop debugger to iteratively refine low-level robotic control code, demonstrated on camera-arm calibration and pick-and-place tasks.
tldr_zh: ModuLoop 利用预训练的大语言模型，通过模块化代码生成和闭环调试器迭代优化低层机器人控制代码，并在相机-机械臂标定和抓取任务中验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型在代码生成与问题求解等多个领域展现出卓越性能。然而，其在机器人控制方面的应用仍十分有限，尤其在需要精准操作、实时反馈及环境依赖执行的底层任务中。针对这一挑战，我们提出闭环模块化代码合成框架。该框架无需针对特定任务进行微调，直接利用预训练大型语言模型执行模块化代码规划与生成，并在迭代执行生成代码的过程中插入调试探测点以观察其行为。这种闭环结构支持系统性的调试与优化，最终生成可执行的控制程序。我们将该框架应用于RGB-D相机与机械臂的标定任务，在真实场景中验证了其有效性。进一步通过后续的抓取-放置任务，不仅证明了标定精度，更展示了框架的潜在扩展性。在两个任务中，该框架均实现了高执行精度与自主性，体现了基于本框架的大语言模型机器人控制的实用性与可扩展性。

title: Towards Compact Autonomous Driving Perception with Balanced Learning and Multi-sensor Fusion
summary: We present a novel compact deep multi-task learning model to handle various autonomous driving perception tasks in one forward pass. The model performs multiple views of semantic segmentation, depth estimation, light detection and ranging (LiDAR) segmentation, and bird's eye view projection simultaneously without being supported by other models. We also provide an adaptive loss weighting algorithm to tackle the imbalanced learning issue that occurred due to plenty of given tasks. Through data pre-processing and intermediate sensor fusion techniques, the model can process and combine multiple input modalities retrieved from RGB cameras, dynamic vision sensors (DVS), and LiDAR placed at several positions on the ego vehicle. Therefore, a better understanding of a dynamically changing environment can be achieved. Based on the ablation study, the model variant trained with our proposed method achieves a better performance. Furthermore, a comparative study is also conducted to clarify its performance and effectiveness against the combination of some recent models. As a result, our model maintains better performance even with much fewer parameters. Hence, the model can inference faster with less GPU memory utilization. Moreover, the result tends to be consistent in 3 different CARLA simulation datasets and 1 real-world nuScenes-lidarseg dataset. To support future research, we share codes and other files publicly at https://github.com/oskarnatan/compact-perception.
tldr: This paper presents a compact multi-task perception model for autonomous driving that handles semantic segmentation, depth estimation, LiDAR segmentation, and BEV projection in one forward pass, using an adaptive loss weighting algorithm and multi-sensor fusion from RGB cameras, DVS, and LiDAR.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的紧凑型多任务感知模型，在一个前向传递中同时处理语义分割、深度估计、LiDAR分割和BEV投影，并采用自适应损失加权算法和多传感器融合（RGB相机、DVS、LiDAR）。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的紧凑型深度多任务学习模型，可在单次前向传播中处理多种自动驾驶感知任务。该模型无需其他模型支持，即可同时执行多视角语义分割、深度估计、激光雷达（LiDAR）分割以及鸟瞰投影。我们还提供了一种自适应损失加权算法，以解决因任务众多而出现的学习不平衡问题。通过数据预处理和中间传感器融合技术，该模型能够处理并融合来自RGB摄像头、动态视觉传感器（DVS）以及安装在自车多个位置的LiDAR所获取的多模态输入。因此，可以实现对动态变化环境更深入的理解。基于消融研究，采用我们提出的方法训练的模型变体取得了更优的性能。此外，我们还进行了对比研究，以阐明其相对于近期一些模型组合的性能与有效性。结果表明，即使参数数量大幅减少，我们的模型仍能保持更优性能。因此，该模型可在降低GPU内存占用的情况下实现更快的推理速度。同时，该结果在3个不同的CARLA仿真数据集和1个真实世界的nuScenes-lidarseg数据集上保持一致。为了支持未来研究，我们已在 https://github.com/oskarnatan/compact-perception 公开共享代码及其他文件。

title: SCOPE: Real-Time Natural Language Camera Agent at the Edge
summary:
Deploying language-driven agents in robotics requires evaluations that reflect real-world task demands: natural-language instructions with reproducible outcomes. Such agents must connect language models to callable perception and control tools, and be assessed using deployment-critical metrics including latency, accuracy, and error modes. We present SCOPE (Simulation and Camera Operations for Perception and Evaluation), a modular agent for natural-language, open-vocabulary pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) camera control and visual scene understanding, designed explicitly for edge deployment. SCOPE operates both in a Blender-based simulation environment and on a physical PTZ camera, executing all perception, planning, and control locally at the deployment site using edge-accessible compute.
  We release a 536-task benchmark spanning QA, single- and multi-step commands, counting, spatial reasoning, descriptions, and optical character recognition in a Blender-based simulation environment that exposes realistic PTZ control affordances. Execution traces are combined with an LM-as-Judge to evaluate latency, accuracy, and error modes.
  We evaluate 19 planner-perception model combinations pairing Qwen3 small language models (SLMs) with Moondream and Qwen vision-language models (VLMs). Stronger SLMs substantially reduce hallucinations and improve tool routing, leading to more reliable closed-loop behavior. Once a sufficiently capable SLM is used, perception becomes the dominant performance bottleneck. Mixture-of-Experts models on both the planning and perception side consistently match or exceed dense alternatives at latencies and memory footprints comparable to much smaller networks. Quantization provides additional efficiency gains with minimal accuracy degradation, identifying a practical, sim-to-real validated design point for real-time, edge-feasible language-driven PTZ control.
tldr: SCOPE is a language-driven PTZ camera agent for edge deployment, combining a planner (SLM) and perception (VLM) with a Blender simulation and physical camera, evaluated on a 536-task benchmark for latency, accuracy, and error modes.
tldr_zh: SCOPE 是一个面向边缘部署的语言驱动 PTZ 摄像头代理，结合规划器（SLM）和感知器（VLM），在 Blender 仿真和物理摄像头上评估了 536 个任务的延迟、准确性和错误模式。
summary_zh:
在机器人领域部署语言驱动的智能体，需要采用能够反映真实世界任务需求的评估方式：即基于自然语言指令且结果可复现。这类智能体必须将语言模型与可调用的感知及控制工具相连接，并借助部署关键指标（包括延迟、准确率和错误模式）进行评估。我们提出SCOPE（面向感知与评估的仿真与相机操作）——一个用于自然语言、开放词汇的云台变焦（PTZ）相机控制及视觉场景理解的模块化智能体，专为边缘部署设计。SCOPE既可在基于Blender的仿真环境中运行，也可在实体PTZ相机上运作，在部署现场利用边缘可访问的计算资源，本地执行所有感知、规划与控制任务。

我们发布了一个包含536项任务的基准测试，涵盖问答、单步与多步指令、计数、空间推理、描述及光学字符识别，该测试在暴露真实PTZ控制属性的Blender仿真环境中进行。执行轨迹结合语言模型作为评判器（LM-as-Judge），用于评估延迟、准确率及错误模式。

我们评估了19种规划器-感知模型组合，将Qwen3小语言模型（SLM）与Moondream及Qwen视觉语言模型（VLM）配对。更强的SLM显著减少了幻觉，并改进了工具路由，从而带来了更可靠的闭环行为。一旦使用了足够强大的SLM，感知便成为主导性能瓶颈。在规划与感知两侧，混合专家模型在延迟与内存占用上与更小的网络相当，同时始终匹配或超越密集替代方案。量化在最小化精度下降的前提下进一步提升了效率，为边缘可行、语言驱动的实时PTZ控制确定了一个从仿真到现实验证的实用设计点。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Cross-domain Videos with Video Prediction Model
summary: Reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually distinct domains is challenging due to the absence of reward signals and the presence of domain gaps. We introduce XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap. More specifically, XIPER trains a cross-domain video prediction model that maps agent observations into the expert domain and uses the prediction likelihood as a reward signal. Experiments on the DMC Color Suite (8 tasks) and DMC Body Suite (3 tasks) show that XIPER consistently outperforms baselines despite domain gaps such as differences in agent color and morphology. We further analyze XIPER on a sim-to-real transfer dataset, demonstrating that it produces meaningful reward signals for real-robot observations given only simulated expert videos. Code, pretrained models, datasets and video demonstrations can be found on our project webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/xiper
tldr: XIPER uses a cross-domain video prediction model to generate reward signals for reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually different domains (e.g., color, morphology, sim-to-real), outperforming baselines on DMC tasks and showing applicability to real-robot scenarios.
tldr_zh: XIPER 利用跨域视频预测模型为强化学习从视觉不同的专家视频中生成奖励信号，在DMC任务上优于基线，并展示了在真实机器人场景中的适用性。
summary_zh: 从视觉差异明显的领域中的专家视频进行强化学习，由于缺乏奖励信号且存在领域差异，具有挑战性。我们提出XIPER（跨域视频预测奖励），这是一种奖励模型，用于从视觉不同领域中收集的专家视频进行学习，其中智能体的外观因颜色、形态或仿真到现实的差异等因素而不同。具体而言，XIPER训练一个跨域视频预测模型，将智能体的观测映射到专家领域，并使用预测似然作为奖励信号。在DMC Color Suite（8个任务）和DMC Body Suite（3个任务）上的实验表明，尽管存在智能体颜色和形态等领域的差异，XIPER始终优于基线方法。我们进一步在仿真到现实迁移数据集上分析XIPER，证明仅凭模拟专家视频，它就能为真实机器人观测产生有意义的奖励信号。代码、预训练模型、数据集和视频演示可在我们的项目网页找到：https://sites.google.com/view/xiper

title: PatchScene: Patch-based Voxel Diffusion for Large-Scale Scene Completion
summary: We propose PatchScene, a novel diffusion-based framework for large-scale LiDAR scene completion. Unlike existing methods that rely on global latent representations or dense voxel grids, PatchScene adopts a patch-based voxel diffusion paradigm that explicitly generates fine-grained geometry within localized 3D regions. To ensure coherent reconstruction at both spatial and temporal scales, we introduce a confidence-guided spatio-temporal fusion mechanism that integrates overlapping patches and adjacent frames in a unified generative process. Furthermore, we design an Annular-Flow diffusion strategy that leverages the radial density pattern of LiDAR scans to progressively propagate high-fidelity information from near-range to far-range regions, enabling spatially unbounded scene completion. Extensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI benchmark demonstrate that PatchScene achieves state-of-the-art performance across all standard metrics, surpassing previous approaches in both geometric accuracy and temporal consistency. Remarkably, the model trained on 20 m LiDAR ranges generalizes effectively to 50 m scenes without retraining, highlighting its strong scalability and generalization capability for real-world autonomous driving applications.
tldr: PatchScene proposes a patch-based voxel diffusion framework for large-scale LiDAR scene completion, introducing confidence-guided spatio-temporal fusion and an Annular-Flow diffusion strategy to achieve state-of-the-art geometric accuracy and temporal consistency, with strong generalization to longer ranges for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: PatchScene 提出了一种基于块的体素扩散框架，用于大规模 LiDAR 场景补全，通过置信度引导的时空融合和环形流扩散策略，在几何精度和时间一致性上达到最先进水平，并具有面向自动驾驶的强泛化能力。
summary_zh: 我们提出PatchScene，一种基于扩散模型的大规模激光雷达场景补全新框架。不同于依赖全局隐式表征或密集体素网格的现有方法，PatchScene采用基于块的体素扩散范式，在局部三维区域内显式生成精细几何结构。为确保时空尺度上的连贯重建，我们引入置信度引导的时空融合机制，在统一生成过程中整合重叠块与相邻帧。此外，我们设计了环形流扩散策略，利用激光雷达扫描的径向密度模式，将近距离的高保真信息逐步传播至远距离区域，从而实现空间无界场景补全。在SemanticKITTI基准上的大量实验表明，PatchScene在所有标准指标上均达到最优性能，在几何精度与时间一致性方面超越先前方法。值得注意的是，在20米激光雷达范围上训练的模型无需重新训练即可有效泛化至50米场景，彰显了其在真实自动驾驶应用中的强大可扩展性与泛化能力。

title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
summary: World models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide complementary capabilities for predicting future outcomes from static visual observations. World models can generate concrete visual rollouts of possible futures, while MLLMs can reason abstractly over questions, goals, and rules. However, generated rollouts are stochastic and may be visually plausible but task-incorrect, making it necessary to determine when visual simulation is useful, whether a rollout is credible, and how it should influence the final answer. We formulate this problem as controlled concrete reasoning, where a model learns to invoke, verify, and integrate visual future simulation alongside abstract reasoning. To study this setting, we construct two human-verified benchmarks, VRQABench for controllable spatial lookahead and OpenWorldQA for open-domain physical prediction, and propose Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD). During training, PF-OPSD uses ground-truth future videos and answers only as teacher-side privileged context to evaluate on-policy concrete-reasoning trajectories, while the deployable student never observes true futures at test time. Experimental results show that PF-OPSD outperforms baseline by 10.6% and 10.9% on VRQABench and OpenWorldQA, respectively, while increasing robustness to noisy or conflicting rollouts. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/yczhou001/PF-OPSD.
tldr: This paper proposes PF-OPSD, a self-distillation method that enables a model to learn when to use world model rollouts versus abstract language reasoning for future prediction tasks, with new benchmarks for spatial and physical reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 PF-OPSD，一种自蒸馏方法，使模型学会在预测未来任务中何时使用世界模型生成的视觉推演、何时使用抽象语言推理，并构建了空间与物理推理的新基准。
summary_zh: 世界模型与多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于静态视觉观测预测未来结果方面具有互补能力。世界模型可生成关于可能未来的具体视觉推演，而多模态大语言模型能够对问题、目标与规则进行抽象推理。然而，生成的推演结果具有随机性，且可能在视觉上合理却与任务不符，因此需要判断视觉仿真何时有效、推演结果是否可信，以及应如何影响最终答案。我们将此问题定义为受控具体推理——即模型学习在抽象推理的同时，对视觉未来仿真进行调用、验证与整合。为研究这一场景，我们构建了两个经过人工验证的基准数据集：用于可控空间前瞻的VRQABench，以及用于开放域物理预测的OpenWorldQA，并提出“特权未来在策略自蒸馏”（PF-OPSD）方法。在训练阶段，PF-OPSD仅将真实未来视频与答案作为教师侧特权上下文，用以评估在策略的具体推理轨迹；而可部署的学生模型在测试时从未观测真实未来。实验结果表明，PF-OPSD在VRQABench与OpenWorldQA上分别比基线方法提升10.6%和10.9%，同时增强了对噪声或冲突推演结果的鲁棒性。我们的代码与数据集已在https://github.com/yczhou001/PF-OPSD公开。

title: ATLAS: A Large-Scale Evaluation Benchmark for Adversarial LiDAR Perception
summary: Autonomous driving perception is typically evaluated on clean benchmark data, yet real-world deployment requires robustness to rare, structured, and potentially adversarial sensor anomalies. This gap is especially critical for LiDAR, where external actors can physically manipulate the sensing process to induce black-box perception failures without accessing the model. Existing LiDAR benchmarks provide little visibility into this failure mode. Prior adversarial LiDAR studies have largely centered on attack hardware, geometric and algorithmic defenses, and early-generation detectors, leaving the robustness of modern perception systems unexplored. To address this evaluation gap, we introduce ATLAS (Adversarial Temporal LiDAR Attack Suite), the first large-scale, physically grounded evaluation benchmark for LiDAR perception models under black-box sensor attacks, simulating the two primary attack modes -- point injection and point removal -- across real driving sequences. Evaluating a broad cross-section of current state-of-the-art LiDAR perception models, ATLAS reveals a surprising robustness asymmetry: models with stronger performance on standard benchmarks tend to better withstand removal attacks, yet are actually more vulnerable to injection attacks than weaker models. We trace this vulnerability to standard object database sampling augmentations, revealing how current training practices can induce architecture-agnostic robustness failures, and study initial directions for mitigating both attack modes. We release the ATLAS generation code to support extensible, reproducible evaluations as attack capabilities evolve, helping make black-box sensor robustness an explicit consideration in future LiDAR perception development.
tldr: ATLAS is a large-scale, physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LiDAR perception models under black-box adversarial sensor attacks, revealing a robustness asymmetry where stronger models are more vulnerable to injection attacks.
tldr_zh: ATLAS是一个大规模的、物理仿真的黑盒传感器攻击下的LiDAR感知模型评估基准，揭示了强模型对注入攻击更脆弱的鲁棒性不对称现象。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶感知通常在干净的基准数据上进行评估，然而实际部署要求对罕见、结构化且可能具有对抗性的传感器异常具有鲁棒性。这一差距对激光雷达尤为关键——外部行为者可通过物理手段操控传感过程，在不访问模型的情况下引发黑盒感知故障。现有激光雷达基准对此类故障模式的可见性极低。此前针对激光雷达的对抗性研究主要集中于攻击硬件、几何与算法防御以及早期检测器，未涉及现代感知系统的鲁棒性。为填补这一评估空白，我们提出ATLAS（对抗性时间激光雷达攻击套件），这是首个面向黑盒传感器攻击下激光雷达感知模型的大规模、物理可行性评估基准，模拟了真实驾驶序列中的两种主要攻击模式——点注入与点移除。通过对当前最先进激光雷达感知模型的广泛评估，ATLAS揭示了一个惊人的鲁棒性不对称现象：在标准基准上性能更强的模型更能抵御移除攻击，但面对注入攻击时反而比弱模型更脆弱。我们将这一脆弱性追溯至标准的目标数据库采样增强方法，揭示了当前训练实践如何引发与架构无关的鲁棒性失效，并研究了缓解两种攻击模式的初步方向。我们公开ATLAS生成代码，以支持随攻击能力演进的可扩展、可复现评估，助力将黑盒传感器鲁棒性纳入未来激光雷达感知开发的明确考量。

title: VLESA: Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent for Human Activity Monitoring
summary: As AI systems increasingly assist humans in physical tasks, ensuring safety becomes paramount -- physical actions carry immediate and irreversible consequences that digital errors do not. We introduce the Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent (VLESA), a framework that monitors human activities from egocentric video and triggers real-time safety interventions when dangerous actions are predicted. VLESA addresses intent-dependent safety where identical actions can be safe or dangerous depending on context. A dataset pairing egocentric frames with goal-conditioned safety annotations is introduced, enabling a goal-conditioned safety Q-filter trained via GRPO that evaluates actions with respect to inferred intent without retraining. On top of that, an intent-action prediction agent is proposed to jointly infer goals and predict future actions from video. On the ASIMOV-2.0 benchmark, VLESA achieves higher intervention accuracy at the exact ground-truth frame compared to baselines, while the GRPO-trained Q-filter improves action safety by over 41 percentage points through goal-conditioned constrained decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/HanjiangHu/VLESA.
tldr: VLESA is a vision-language safety agent that monitors human activities via egocentric video and triggers real-time interventions when dangerous actions are predicted, using a goal-conditioned Q-filter trained with GRPO.
tldr_zh: VLESA是一个视觉-语言安全代理，通过自我中心视频监控人类活动，并在预测到危险动作时触发实时干预，使用通过GRPO训练的目标条件Q过滤器。
summary_zh: 随着人工智能系统越来越多地辅助人类完成物理任务，确保安全性变得至关重要——物理行为会带来即时且不可逆转的后果，而数字错误则不具备这一特性。我们提出了视觉-语言具身安全智能体（VLESA），该框架通过第一人称视角视频监控人类活动，并在预测到危险行为时触发实时安全干预。VLESA旨在应对依赖意图的安全问题：同一动作可能因环境不同而表现为安全或危险。我们引入了一个将第一人称视角帧与目标条件安全标注配对的数据集，并基于GRPO训练了目标条件安全Q滤波器，使其能够在无需重新训练的情况下，根据推断出的意图评估动作。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了意图-动作预测智能体，用于联合推断目标并从视频中预测未来动作。在ASIMOV-2.0基准测试中，VLESA在精确的真实标注帧上相比基线方法实现了更高的干预准确率，而经过GRPO训练的Q滤波器通过目标条件约束解码，将动作安全性提升了超过41个百分点。代码已开源至https://github.com/HanjiangHu/VLESA。

title: DyaPlex: Full-Duplex Speech-Motion Model for Dyadic Interaction
summary: We present DyaPlex, a streaming, full-duplex speech-and-motion model designed for dyadic interaction. To capture the continuous and reciprocal nature of human communication, this full-duplex capability empowers the agent to simultaneously perceive and generate both speech and physical motion in a streaming fashion. At its core, our method leverages the strong priors of a foundational full-duplex speech model and integrates a novel motion pathway, thereby achieving fully synchronized multi-modal interaction. Specifically, we design a dual-tower Transformer architecture that preserves the zero-shot conversational reasoning of a frozen base speech model while constructing a deeply coupled, streaming motion pathway. By introducing a unified dyadic token interleaving mechanism and guiding cross-attention via a time-aligned speech-motion RoPE, our model effectively aligns autoregressive motions with rich latent speech features. Trained on the 4,000-hour Seamless Interaction dataset, our model effectively captures cross-speaker dependencies and establishes new state-of-the-art performance across both monadic and dyadic human interaction benchmarks.
tldr: DyaPlex introduces a streaming, full-duplex speech-motion model for dyadic interaction, integrating a motion pathway into a frozen speech foundation model to enable synchronized multimodal generation.
tldr_zh: DyaPlex提出了一种用于双人交互的流式全双工语音-运动模型，将运动路径集成到冻结的语音基础模型中，实现同步的多模态生成。
summary_zh: 我们介绍DyaPlex，一种面向双人交互的流式全双工语音与动作模型。为捕捉人类沟通中连续且相互的交互特性，该全双工能力使智能体能够以流式方式同时感知并生成语音与物理动作。其核心方法利用基础全双工语音模型的强先验知识，并集成新型动作通路，从而实现完全同步的多模态交互。具体而言，我们设计了双塔Transformer架构，在保持冻结基础语音模型零样本对话推理能力的同时，构建深度耦合的流式动作通路。通过引入统一的双人交互令牌交错机制，并利用时间对齐的语音-动作旋转位置编码指导交叉注意力，该模型有效实现了自回归动作与丰富潜在语音特征的对齐。基于4000小时无缝交互数据集的训练，本模型成功捕捉跨说话人依赖关系，在单人及双人人机交互基准测试中均创下最新最优性能记录。

title: Optimal Design and Analytical Modeling of a Soft Fin-Ray Effect Gripper Finger Using the Finite Rigid Elements Method
summary: Fin Ray-inspired soft grippers offer a promising solution for gently handling delicate, irregular objects, especially in agriculture. The objective of this research is to design, fabricate, and model a Fin Ray Effect (FRE) soft gripper finger to enable precise force control in future applications. This design aims to gently grasp delicate agricultural products, such as tomatoes, that require both adaptability and accurate force application. To address the inherent challenges of soft robotics, including nonlinear behavior, infinite degrees of freedom, and variable material properties, the Finite Rigid Elements Method (FREM) was employed for modeling. This method preserves analytical accuracy while providing a reliable foundation for the development of a force controller in later stages. A detailed Finite Element Model (FEM) was created using ANSYS, and the analytical results were validated through simulation and experimental testing. The gripper's fingers were optimized based on four key criteria: tip displacement, total deflection, stress distribution, and contact force. The optimal finger configuration includes a length of 30 mm, rib spacing of 10 mm, seven ribs angled at -15 deg, and a rib thickness of 1 mm. Theoretical modeling using the FREM predicted finger deformation with a 3% error, while the ANSYS numerical model achieved 2% error.
tldr: This paper presents the optimal design and analytical modeling of a soft Fin-Ray effect gripper finger for delicate agricultural grasping, using the Finite Rigid Elements Method to model nonlinear behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了用于农业中轻柔抓取的软体Fin-Ray效应夹爪手指的优化设计与解析建模，采用有限刚性单元法对非线性行为进行建模。
summary_zh: 受鳍条启发的软体夹爪为轻柔抓取精致且形状不规则的物体（特别是在农业领域）提供了一种极具前景的解决方案。本研究旨在设计、制造并建模一种基于鳍条效应（FRE）的软体夹爪手指，以便在未来应用中实现精确的力控制。该设计旨在轻柔抓取诸如番茄等既需适应性强又要求精准施力的精致农产品。为应对软体机器人固有的非线性行为、无限自由度及可变材料特性等挑战，本研究采用了有限刚性单元法（FREM）进行建模。该方法在保持分析精度的同时，为后续力控制器的开发提供了可靠基础。利用ANSYS建立了详细的有限元模型（FEM），并通过仿真与实验测试对分析结果进行了验证。基于指尖位移、总变形量、应力分布及接触力四项关键指标对夹爪手指进行了优化。优化的手指构型为：长度30毫米、肋间距10毫米、7根肋条呈-15度角、肋条厚度1毫米。采用FREM进行的理论建模预测手指变形的误差为3%，而ANSYS数值模型的误差为2%。

title: Neural Navigation Functions for Zero-Shot Generalizable Motion Planning
summary: We introduce Neural Navigation Functions (Neural-NF), a learned reactive navigation function capable of zero-shot transfer across unseen environment geometries. Neural-NF places data-driven adaptation within a structured elliptic planner, where the navigation objective is learned while planner structure is preserved by construction. Specifically, intrinsic Laplacian-derived features are mapped to local PDE coefficients, and solving the resulting boundary value problem produces a globally consistent value function on each target domain. For every admissible learned model, the resulting policy is collision-free, provides monotonic descent and a global minimum at the goal by construction. This admits a linearly-solvable optimal-control interpretation for any parameter setting. Empirically, Neural-NF achieves strong zero-shot transfer across diverse geometries and outperforms learned planners that directly predict the value function by up to a $5\times$ improvement.
tldr: Neural-NF learns a navigation function via Laplacian-based PDE features that guarantees collision-free, globally convergent motion planning, enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen environments.
tldr_zh: Neural-NF 通过学习基于拉普拉斯 PDE 特征的导航函数，保证碰撞避免和全局收敛，实现零样本迁移到未知环境。
summary_zh: 我们引入神经导航函数（Neural-NF），一种具备学习能力的反应式导航函数，能够在未见过的环境几何结构上实现零样本迁移。Neural-NF将数据驱动的自适应过程嵌入结构化的椭圆规划器中，其中导航目标通过学习获得，而规划器结构通过构造方式得以保留。具体而言，基于拉普拉斯算子的内在特征被映射为局部偏微分方程系数，求解由此产生的边值问题可在每个目标域上生成全局一致的价值函数。对于每个可接受的学习模型，所得到的策略天然具有无碰撞特性、单调递减性质，并且目标点处存在全局最小值。这种设计使得任意参数设置下的线性可解最优控制解释成为可能。实验表明，Neural-NF在不同几何结构间展现出强大的零样本迁移能力，其性能相比直接预测价值函数的已学习规划器提升高达6倍。

title: Toward Gripper-Integrated Active Electrosense for Pre-Contact Sensing in Underwater Soft Grippers
summary: Underwater manipulation often occurs under degraded visibility due to turbidity, glare, and gripper occlusion, limiting the reliability of vision-based perception during approach and grasping. In such settings, soft grippers are well suited for compliant interaction, but they typically lack an onboard pre-contact cue that can guide approach and closure when vision is unreliable. This extended abstract explores active electrosense as a lightweight sensing modality that can provide a proximity-like signal prior to contact by measuring perturbations of an applied electric field in conductive media. We instrument an octopus-inspired gripper with a discrete electrode layout and record multi-channel sensing voltages using off-the-shelf hardware. Simulation and tank experiments with a suspended conductive sphere show structured, object-dependent changes in the multi-electrode voltage readout relative to empty-water baselines, with detectability varying across excitation of 5 to 20 V and frequencies from 1 mHz to 1 kHz. These findings motivate systematic investigation of gripper-integrated electrosense as a complementary pre-contact cue for underwater soft manipulation.
tldr: This paper explores using active electrosense as a pre-contact sensing modality for underwater soft grippers, showing that multi-electrode voltage patterns change detectably with an object's presence in conductive fluid.
tldr_zh: 本文探索了在水下软体夹爪中使用主动电感知作为预接触传感方式，展示了多电极电压模式在导电液体中因物体存在而发生的可检测变化。
summary_zh: 水下作业常因水体浑浊、眩光及夹爪遮挡导致能见度下降，使得基于视觉的感知在接近与抓取阶段的可靠性受限。在此类环境中，软体夹爪虽适用于柔顺交互，但通常缺乏在视觉失效时引导接近与闭合的预接触信号。本拓展摘要探讨了主动电感知技术作为一种轻量化传感模态的可行性——通过测量导电介质中施加电场的扰动，该技术可在接触前提供类似接近信号的反馈。我们采用离散电极布局仿照章鱼触手设计夹爪，并利用商用硬件记录多通道传感电压。在悬浮导电球体的仿真与水槽实验中，多电极电压读数相对于空水基线呈现出结构化且随目标变化的特征，其可检测性随激励电压（5至20伏）及频率（1毫赫至1千赫）的改变而差异显著。这些发现推动了将集成电感知技术系统性地引入软体水下操作领域，使其成为预接触阶段互补性感知手段的研究方向。

title: Exact equivariance, kept through training, buys zero-shot generalisation across the symmetry group
summary: A latent world model built from an equivariant encoder $E$ and an equivariant predictor $f$ inherits a provable symmetry of its training loss: when the world's dynamics genuinely carries a group $G$ acting on latents by an orthogonal representation $ρ(g)$, the one-step prediction relMSE is exactly invariant across the whole group, so fitting the dynamics on a restricted slice of orientations mathematically determines it on the entire orbit (jǔ yī fǎn sān). We verify this end-to-end at laptop scale (CPU/MPS, fully seeded). [A] The symmetry survives a real Muon/AdamW + EMA + VICReg run -- composed encode-then-predict residual $\sim 10^{-6}$ after optimisation, not just at initialisation, and under any optimiser. [B] One-step error is flat to five digits across the group, while a same-hypothesis-class non-equivariant baseline fits the slice but breaks out-of-distribution (VN $\times 1.00$ vs baseline $\times 13.8$ in 2D, $\times 17.2$ in 3D, $\times 157$ over the full $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ ladder), with the equivariant model $4.5$-$7.4\times$ smaller. [C] The same isometry argument lifts to closed loop: under a matching equivariant planner the control trajectory at orientation $g$ is exactly $ρ(g)$ applied to the seen one, so closed-loop error is invariant across the group -- float-floor-exact in 2D/$\mathrm{SO}(2)$ on real PushT and statistically flat in 3D/$\mathrm{SE}(3)$ (disjoint 95% CIs). We stress-test the prior against Sutton's Bitter Lesson: augmentation, brute-force scale, and soft-equivariance each close at most the across-group task metric, never the float-floor exactness. Because equivariance is closed under composition, the $H$-fold rollout stays flat ($\times 1.00$, $\le 2\times 10^{-7}$) at every horizon, while the baseline's residual compounds with $H$. Out of scope: task-success sweeps, planner-free invariance, and scaling.
tldr: This paper shows that an equivariant world model, built from an equivariant encoder and predictor, achieves exact invariance of the prediction loss across the symmetry group, leading to zero-shot generalization to unseen orientations and compounding rollout stability, verified on small-scale experiments including PushT.
tldr_zh: 本文证明，由等变编码器和等变预测器构建的潜在世界模型，其预测损失在对称群上精确不变，从而实现对未见方向的零样本泛化和稳定展开，并在包括PushT的小规模实验中验证。
summary_zh: 基于等变编码器 $E$ 和等变预测器 $f$ 构建的潜空间世界模型，其训练损失具有可证明的对称性：当世界动力学真正承载一个群 $G$，且该群通过正交表示 $ρ(g)$ 作用于潜变量时，单步预测 relMSE 在整个群上精确不变，因此仅在一个有向切片上拟合动力学，即可在数学上确定整个轨道上的动力学（举一反三）。我们在笔记本电脑规模（CPU/MPS，全种子设定）上端到端验证了这一性质。[A] 该对称性在实际的 Muon/AdamW + EMA + VICReg 运行中依然保持——经优化后，编码-预测残差约为 $10^{-6}$，这不仅在初始化时成立，在任何优化器下均成立。[B] 单步误差在整个群上平坦至五位有效数字，而同一假设类下的非等变基线可拟合该切片，但在分布外数据上失效（二维中 VN $\times 1.00$ 对比基线 $\times 13.8$，三维中 $\times 17.2$，在整个 $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ 阶梯上 $\times 157$），且等变模型规模小 $4.5$-$7.4$ 倍。[C] 相同的等距性论证可推广到闭环场景：在匹配的等变规划器下，方向 $g$ 上的控制轨迹恰好是观测轨迹经 $ρ(g)$ 作用后的结果，因此闭环误差在整个群上不变——在真实 PushT 的二维/$\mathrm{SO}(2)$ 场景中达到浮点精度级精确，在三维/$\mathrm{SE}(3)$ 场景中统计上平坦（95% 置信区间不重叠）。我们对这一先验进行了压力测试，对比 Sutton 的苦涩教训：数据增强、暴力规模扩展和软等变方法最多只能在跨群任务指标上接近，而无法达到浮点精度级的精确性。由于等变性在复合运算下封闭，$H$ 步展开在每个预测步均保持平坦（$\times 1.00$，$\le 2\times 10^{-7}$），而基线残差随 $H$ 复合增长。未涵盖内容：任务成功率扫描、无规划器情况下的不变性，以及规模扩展。

title: SEAOTTER: Sensor Embedded Autoencoding with One-Time Transcode for Efficient Reconstruction
summary: In robotics systems, vast amounts of visual data are easily captured at high resolution using low-cost, low-power hardware. Yet, limited bandwidth and on-device compute resources prevent full utilization when transmitted via conventional codecs like JPEG/MPEG. Newer codecs, like AV1/AVIF, improve the rate-distortion trade-off, but demand far more resources for encoding, impractical without custom ASICs. Recent asymmetric autoencoders deliver high quality under extreme power and bandwidth constraints, but add prohibitive decoding cost and use bespoke formats that ignore decades of infrastructure built around standards like JPEG. To address these limitations, we introduce a compression framework for cloud robotics based on a Sensor Embedded Autoencoder paired with a One-Time Transcode for Efficient Reconstruction (SEAOTTER). Because the sensor, cloud, and consumer stages face very different power and bandwidth budgets, SEAOTTER combines the compactness of a learned latent with the broad usability of a standard JPEG file. Since naive transcoding degrades performance, we propose a learnable JPEG color and quantization transform that enables increased accuracy for global, dense, and vision-language-based perception. Using SEAOTTER, we train both general-purpose and task-aware transcoding pipelines for a pre-trained, frozen encoder. At a compression ratio of 200:1 and compared to AVIF, we observe 7 times faster encoding, 3.5 times faster decoding, and +8% ImageNet top-1 accuracy, while retaining compatibility with JPEG infrastructure. Our code is available at https://github.com/UT-SysML/seaotter .
tldr: SEAOTTER proposes a compression framework for cloud robotics that combines a learned latent representation with standard JPEG compatibility, enabling efficient encoding/decoding and improved perception accuracy under extreme bandwidth constraints.
tldr_zh: SEAOTTER 提出了一种面向云机器人的压缩框架，将学习到的隐表示与标准 JPEG 兼容性相结合，在极端带宽限制下实现了高效的编解码和更好的感知精度。

title: Face versus Body Tracking for Human-Robot Interaction: An Egocentric Dataset
summary: To enable meaningful human-robot interaction (HRI), a robot must continuously assess engagement by consistently tracking users over time. State-of-the-art computer vision models, however, are heavily optimized for surveillance or autonomous driving. A social robot faces distinct egocentric challenges, such as humans bouncing, obstructing each other, or leaving the frame. Frequent identity switches (IDSW) cause the robot to lose its footing mid-conversation. To address this, we introduce a novel, custom-annotated egocentric dataset collected via the Furhat robot to capture complex social dynamics. We present a systematic evaluation isolating detection errors from tracking logic, comparing face versus body tracking, and assessing the impact of extended spatial memory and appearance re-identification (ReID). Results indicate that increasing spatial memory mitigates prolonged occlusions but fails on complex dynamic events. Integrating ReID resolves complex switches but exhibits opposing effects: it substantially improves body tracking stability, yet causes facial IDSW to spike due to profile angle sensitivity. Ultimately, our optimized pipeline reduces IDSW by 49\%, mitigating interaction breakdowns. Because standard benchmarks lack dense, close-quarter occlusions, this work highlights the critical need for natively captured social dynamics to truly validate HRI perception models.
tldr: Introduces an egocentric dataset for human-robot interaction, systematically evaluating face vs. body tracking under social dynamics and showing that an optimized pipeline with ReID and extended spatial memory reduces identity switches by 49%.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于人机交互的自我中心数据集，系统地比较了面部与身体跟踪在社交动态下的表现，并通过优化管道（结合ReID和扩展空间记忆）将身份切换减少了49%。

title: NVIDIA Isaac Sim: Enabling Scalable, GPU-Accelerated Simulation for Robotics
summary: Simulation has become a core infrastructure for robotics research. Unlike previous simulators, NVIDIA Isaac Sim leverages GPU acceleration to enable large-scale parallel training and physics-accurate modeling. Its synthetic data generation pipeline alleviates the scarcity of high-quality training data, supporting data-driven robot learning and large-scale simulation-centric experimentation. However, existing surveys often treat it as one simulator among many, without a systematic analysis of its architectural characteristics, usage patterns, and limitations. This survey reviews Isaac Sim from system and application perspectives, outlining its architecture and comparing it with widely used simulators. We analyze representative studies across five major domains and summarize common usage patterns, particularly in data generation and high-fidelity simulation. We also outline key future directions and challenges, including physics open-world learning, simulation-centric training and practical usability constraints.
tldr: This survey provides a systematic analysis of NVIDIA Isaac Sim, covering its GPU-accelerated architecture, usage patterns across five robotics domains, and comparisons with other simulators.
tldr_zh: 该综述系统分析了NVIDIA Isaac Sim，涵盖其GPU加速架构、在五个机器人领域的使用模式及与其他模拟器的比较。

title: Static and Dynamic Representations for Tactile Contact-Angle Estimation with Event-Based Sensors
summary: Event-based tactile sensing offers low-latency signal acquisition for contact-rich robotic interaction. This paper investigates contact-angle estimation using event streams from an event-based tactile sensor (NeuroTac) and compares three event-derived spatial contour representations: a dynamic representation capturing recent event activity, a static representation recovering a more persistent contact state, and their combined representation. Across the evaluated motion scenarios, all representation pipelines exhibited P99 processing latency below 10 ms at all tested sampling intervals, demonstrating their potential for high-frequency event-based tactile angle estimation in robotic manipulation. The static representation consistently achieved marginally better performance than the dynamic and combined representations under scenario-specific training, yielding a mean overall MAE of 0.160° during continuous sensor rolling and a stop-phase mean MAE of 0.251° during randomly inserted motion interruptions. It also exhibited smaller performance fluctuations across speed and indentation depth variations than the other two representations.
tldr: This paper investigates contact-angle estimation from event-based tactile sensors using dynamic, static, and combined spatial contour representations, achieving low-latency (P99 < 10 ms) and high accuracy (MAE 0.160°) for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于事件触觉传感器（NeuroTac）的接触角估计方法，利用动态、静态及组合空间轮廓表示，在机器人操作中实现了低延迟（P99 < 10 ms）和高精度（MAE 0.160°）。

title: BotDirector: Robot Storytelling Across the Symmetrical Reality with Multi-modal Interactions
summary: Robot storytelling offers a unique blend of technological innovation and creative expression that engages children in unprecedented ways. However, the technical aspects are often too complicated for children. We propose an interactive system that facilitates robot storytelling with tangible and natural language interactions. Children arrange the playground with their own stuff and create narratives with an LLM agent. The created narratives are transformed into a motion sequence based on the map and characters, and the motions are executed by self-navigating swarm robots. This system enhances robot storytelling with flexible scenarios, enabling young children to create robot dramas with everyday objects.
tldr: An interactive robot storytelling system that enables children to create narratives via an LLM agent and execute them with self-navigating swarm robots using tangible and language interactions.
tldr_zh: 一个交互式机器人讲故事系统，儿童可通过LLM代理创建叙事，并使用自导航群机器人通过实体和语言交互执行。

title: Hybrid Dynamics Modeling for a Flexible 2-DoF Robotic Arm
summary: This paper examines three approaches for modeling the dynamics of a flexible-link 2-DoF robotic arm to address unmodeled dynamics not captured by rigid-body models. Two physics informed models combine rigid-body dynamics (RBD) formulations with a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to capture residual model errors and linkage flexibility. A kinematics-based regression model serves as a purely data-driven baseline. Using an open-source dataset, torque predictions are first estimated using Ridge regression on kinematic features, while the physicsbased baseline is constructed from published specifications, and ordinary least-squares regression is subsequently used to estimate the same parameter set directly from data. Results show that the physics-based parameters yield the poorest accuracy, while regularized and least-squares estimators align more closely with measured torques. Residual analysis and error metrics highlight the limitations of purely parametric models for flexible-link systems and underscore the value of regularization and data-driven identification, supporting developments of semi-parametric residual learning methods.
tldr: This paper compares physics-informed and data-driven dynamics models for a flexible 2-DoF robotic arm, finding that regularized regression outperforms purely parametric physics-based models.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了针对柔性2-DoF机械臂的物理信息和数据驱动动力学模型，发现正则化回归优于纯参数物理模型。

title: TASE: Truncation-Aware Semantic Embeddings for 3D Scene Understanding and Editing
summary: High-fidelity semantic 3D scene representations are crucial for numerous applications, including robotics, autonomous driving, and simulation. Beyond this, the ability to edit such representations enables developers to adapt these applications more easily to specific target scenarios. Current approaches provide limited support for controllable editing. We introduce TASE, a method that projects pretrained 2D semantic features into a truncation-aware embedding space to enable flexible 3D scene editing. Our method explicitly optimizes a feature space in which progressively reducing feature channels yields increasingly abstract semantic representations, while retaining more channels preserves fine-grained detail. Additionally, we improve multi-view consistency of the features using a scale- and translation-equivariance loss. The resulting truncation-aware embedding space enables text-driven edits to 3D scenes, providing explicit control over how strongly edits adhere to the original scene content and allowing more substantial modifications than prior methods. Moreover, we propose a finetuning stage for the editing diffusion model to mitigate artifacts caused by geometric changes. Experimental results demonstrate competitive performance in 3D scene editing, substantially outperforming prior methods on edits involving large geometric modifications.
tldr: TASE projects pretrained 2D semantic features into a truncation-aware embedding space, enabling controllable text-driven 3D scene editing with explicit trade-off between adherence to original content and degree of modification.
tldr_zh: TASE 将预训练的 2D 语义特征映射到可截断的嵌入空间，实现对 3D 场景的可控文本驱动编辑，并能在保留原内容与修改程度之间显式权衡。

title: Consistent Yet Wrong: Evidence Insensitivity in Spatial Vision-Language Models
tldr: This paper introduces ViewDiag, a multi-view benchmark to evaluate spatial reasoning in VLMs, revealing that consistent cross-view predictions often arise from prior-driven collapse rather than genuine geometric understanding.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ViewDiag，一个多视角基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型的空间推理能力，发现跨视角一致的预测往往源于先验驱动下的坍缩而非真正的几何理解。

title: Exploring Easy Boosts for Lidar Semantic Scene Completion
summary: This paper investigates "free lunch" strategies to boost the performance of lidar semantic scene completion (SSC) without requiring complex architectural redesigns. We first demonstrate that endowing input point clouds with semantic pseudo-labels from off-the-shelf segmentors significantly improves the performance of existing architectures. By evaluating these models against an oracle, we establish that high-quality semantic priors are a primary driver of mIoU gains. Furthermore, we equip the input lidar scan with visibility information that distinguishes between empty and unknown spaces, which provides a secondary performance boost across the tested architectures. Using these simple enhancements, we observe that older models remain competitive with state-of-the-art systems, and can even outperform them. Our code is available at https://github.com/astra-vision/SSC-Priors.
tldr: This paper shows that adding semantic pseudo-labels to point clouds and encoding visibility information significantly boosts Lidar Semantic Scene Completion (SSC) performance without complex architectural changes.
tldr_zh: 本文证明，将来自现成分割器的语义伪标签添加到点云中并编码可见性信息，可以在不修改复杂架构的情况下显著提升激光雷达语义场景补全的性能。

title: Multi-Robot Bearing-only Pose Estimation via Angle Rigidity
summary: This letter proposes a novel distributed bearing-based pose estimator for time-varying multi-robot systems. The method uses angles computed from body-frame bearings to estimate the robots' positions in $\mathbb{R}^3$ without knowledge of their orientations. The orientations in $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ are recovered from the estimated positions, the bearings, and the bearing derivatives. The proposed observer only requires the (directed) sensing topology to be \textit{angle-rigid}, a weaker condition than the commonly used ones like bearing rigidity. Local uniform exponential stability of the proposed observer is established under the assumption of persistently exciting motions for a subset of robots. Simulations are presented and discussed to evaluate the scheme's effectiveness and practicality.
tldr: A distributed bearing-based pose estimator for multi-robot systems using angle rigidity, enabling position estimation in 3D without orientation knowledge and guaranteed exponential stability.
tldr_zh: 一种基于角度刚性的分布式多机器人仅方位姿态估计方法，无需方向信息即可在三维空间中估计位置并保证指数稳定性。
